# Mirage 1.1.6
本版本新增 Mirage Editor，可在 macOS 上编辑 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸工程；同时加入场景壁纸移动端预渲染、多屏视频共享播放、屏保与动态锁屏跟随桌面，并修复桌面恢复、视频唤醒、场景音频和主窗口交互等问题。
## 重大更新：Mirage Editor
- 新增主窗口「编辑器」入口，基于 Wallpaper Engine 编辑器组件提供工程打开、编辑、保存和实时 GPU 预览，并适配 macOS 窗口控制、工程选择及浅色、深色外观。 - 首次使用复用 Mirage 的 Steam 登录，验证当前账号持有的 Wallpaper Engine 永久自有许可证，再从 Steam 下载原版编辑器文件；借用或临时许可证不支持此安装流程。 - 按 Intel 或 Apple Silicon 架构下载并校验所需运行组件，普通 Mirage 安装包无需内置完整编辑器运行环境。Apple Silicon 编辑器要求 macOS 26.5 或更高版本。 - 安装界面显示下载大小、所需空间、文件与分块进度、速度及预计剩余时间，支持并行下载、取消后继续，以及修复、缓存清理和卸载；卸载保留用户工程。 - 编辑器支持 macOS 系统音频采集，让音频响应效果可在预览中工作；使用时需要系统音频采集权限。优化预览纹理共享和频谱着色器编译，减少重复绘制与编译开销。
## Android 场景预渲染导出
- 场景移动端导出新增「预渲染 → 高性能」选项，可将场景转为视频后无线传输或导出 `.mpkg`（PR #87）。 - 支持按已配对手机的屏幕比例裁切或保持原始宽高比，提供裁切预览、对齐调节、自动／全高清／4K UHD 预设，以及 24、30、60 FPS 选项。 - 支持根据场景动画和媒体周期自适应计算视频时长，也可手动选择时长。预渲染结果不包含音频，时钟和触摸交互等实时功能不会继续工作，首尾不保证无缝。
## 多屏播放与桌面同步
- 默认开启「多屏同步视频进度」：使用同一视频且倍速、暂停状态、音量、静音状态和加载方式一致的显示器共享解码、播放进度与声音，减少重复资源占用；各屏幕仍可独立设置填充、位置和 HDR（Issue #91）。 - 新增独立的「屏保跟随桌面」和「动态锁屏跟随桌面」开关，可选择来源显示器，并跟随手动切换或播放列表轮换；网页壁纸或来源显示器断开时保留上次有效配置（Issue #71）。 - 修复视频壁纸在睡眠唤醒后无法恢复播放的问题，改善插拔显示器与锁屏、解锁后壁纸失效或黑屏的情况（Issue #68，PR #92）。 - 修复退出 Mirage 后桌面回落到 macOS 默认壁纸的问题，正确保存和恢复原有系统壁纸，并保护仍被系统引用的占位图片（Issue #95）。
## 场景渲染与音频修复
- 修复场景渲染目标过早复用及持久纹理与临时纹理错误共享的问题，避免不同渲染步骤相互覆盖。 - 修复部分场景脚本产生异常音量值后影响其他应用音频的问题，在音量、混音和最终输出环节过滤无效数值（PR #90）。
## 界面与软件更新
- 新增可选的「主窗口毛玻璃」效果，统一侧栏和内容区域的背景；默认关闭，系统开启「减少透明度」时暂停此效果（Issue #20）。 - 修复开关主窗口触发重复壁纸恢复与桌面捕获而造成的轻微卡顿，仅在实际显示器配置变化时执行相应恢复（Issue #57）。 - 恢复 Command-M 最小化快捷键，修复主窗口标题栏控制按钮，并改进窗口隐藏、最小化及重新打开后的显示刷新（Issue #89）。 - 软件更新改为自动检查并提示，由用户确认后下载和安装；区分「已下载」「正在安装」和「退出后安装」状态，避免提前显示将在退出时安装。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 应用与屏保组件要求 macOS 14.2 或更高版本；原生动态锁屏功能要求 macOS 26 或更高版本 - Apple Silicon 上的 Mirage Editor 另需 macOS 26.5 或更高版本；安装编辑器需要持有 Wallpaper Engine 永久自有许可证的 Steam 账号

# Mirage 1.1.6
This release introduces Mirage Editor for editing Wallpaper Engine projects on macOS. It also adds mobile scene prerendering, shared video playback across displays, and desktop-following screen savers and dynamic lock screens, while fixing desktop restoration, video wake recovery, scene audio, and main-window interactions.
## Major Update: Mirage Editor
- Added an Editor entry in the main window for opening, editing, saving, and previewing projects with Wallpaper Engine editor components. Includes real-time GPU previews, macOS window controls and project selection, and light and dark appearances. - First-time setup reuses Mirage's Steam login, verifies that the current account owns a permanent Wallpaper Engine license, and downloads the original editor files from Steam. Borrowed and temporary licenses are not supported by this installation flow. - Downloads and verifies the required runtime components for Intel or Apple Silicon on demand, keeping the complete editor runtime out of the standard Mirage download. The Apple Silicon editor requires macOS 26.5 or later. - Setup shows download size, required disk space, file and chunk progress, speed, and estimated time remaining. Supports parallel downloads, resuming after cancellation, repair, cache cleanup, and uninstallation; uninstalling preserves user projects. - Added macOS system audio capture for audio-reactive editor previews, requiring system audio capture permission. Optimized shared preview textures and spectrum shader compilation to reduce repeated rendering and compilation work.
## Android Scene Prerendering
- Added the Prerendered → High Performance option for mobile scene exports, converting scenes to video for wireless transfer or `.mpkg` export (PR #87). - Supports cropping to a paired phone's screen aspect ratio or keeping the original aspect ratio, with crop previews, alignment controls, Automatic / Full HD / 4K UHD presets, and 24, 30, or 60 FPS. - Calculates adaptive video durations from scene animation and media cycles, with manual duration choices also available. Prerendered output has no audio, live features such as clocks and touch interactions no longer update, and seamless looping is not guaranteed.
## Multi-display Playback and Desktop Following
- Enabled shared video progress across displays by default. Displays using the same video with matching speed, pause state, volume, mute state, and loading mode share decoding, playback progress, and audio to reduce duplicate resource use. Fill mode, position, and HDR remain configurable per display (Issue #91). - Added independent options for screen savers and dynamic lock screens to follow the desktop, with a selectable source display and support for manual wallpaper changes and playlist rotation. Web wallpapers and disconnected source displays retain the last valid configuration (Issue #71). - Fixed video wallpapers failing to resume after sleep, improving recovery from inactive or black wallpapers after display reconnection and locking or unlocking (Issue #68, PR #92). - Fixed quitting Mirage restoring the macOS default wallpaper instead of the original system wallpaper. Improved wallpaper backup and restoration, and protected placeholder images still referenced by the system (Issue #95).
## Scene Rendering and Audio Fixes
- Fixed premature render-target reuse and incorrect sharing between persistent and temporary textures, preventing rendering steps from overwriting each other's contents. - Fixed invalid volume values from certain scene scripts affecting audio from other applications. Invalid values are now filtered in volume handling, mixing, and final output (PR #90).
## Interface and Software Updates
- Added an optional frosted main-window background across the sidebar and content area. It is off by default and pauses when Reduce Transparency is enabled in macOS (Issue #20). - Fixed brief wallpaper stutters when opening or closing the main window by avoiding redundant wallpaper recovery and desktop capture when the display configuration has not changed (Issue #57). - Restored the Command-M minimize shortcut, fixed main-window title-bar controls, and improved display refresh after hiding, minimizing, or reopening the window (Issue #89). - Automatic updates now check and notify, with user confirmation required before downloading and installing. Downloaded, installing, and install-on-quit states are shown separately, avoiding premature install-on-quit messages.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later - Mirage Editor on Apple Silicon additionally requires macOS 26.5 or later; editor installation requires a Steam account that owns a permanent Wallpaper Engine license

# Mirage 1.1.5
本版本新增壁纸烘焙与 Android 壁纸传输，优化场景渲染性能，并修复播放规则、壁纸缓存、Steam 服务和屏保兼容性等问题。发布包现已使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证。
## 重大更新：壁纸烘焙与 Android 传输
- 新增“烘焙为视频”：将场景、网页和视频壁纸按当前属性生成新的 SDR 视频壁纸，支持输出分辨率预设与自定义尺寸、时长、画质及壁纸自身音频选项，并提供任务进度和取消操作。 - 烘焙结果会固定原壁纸的动态交互，鼠标交互、时钟和实时媒体信息不会继续更新，首尾不保证无缝；网页烘焙需要屏幕录制权限。 - 新增 Wallpaper Engine Android 设备发现、PIN 配对、已配对设备重连，以及兼容视频和场景壁纸的无线传输与 `.mpkg` 导出（PR #30）。 - 场景移动端导出支持质量预设、纹理分辨率和像素画优化。当前不支持网页壁纸、场景预设或预渲染视频导出，场景导出需要 `scene.pkg`。
## 场景性能与渲染兼容性
- 静态场景改为按需渲染，复用文字布局、动画数据与 GPU 资源，并减少空闲音频处理和定时器唤醒，降低不必要的渲染开销。 - 修复场景合成导致部分壁纸全黑的问题（Issue #66），并改进合成图层捕获、渲染目标尺寸、变换效果像素坐标及部分光照效果的兼容性。 - 修复替换图片的比例、填充与裁切更新，以及文字背景、透明度、定位和动态文字尺寸变化后的效果范围。 - 改进 SceneScript 属性初始化、初始化返回值应用和运行时对象绑定；修复粒子实例脚本绑定、手动发射及振荡时序和位移。
## 播放、缓存与稳定性
- 修复刘海屏及 Chrome 多窗口全屏场景下，“其他应用全屏时”播放规则未触发的问题（Issue #73）。 - 排除 Siri 听取、系统提示音和控制中心音量反馈对其他应用音频检测的干扰，减少壁纸音频不必要的暂停或静音（Issue #72）。 - 修复桌面壁纸缓存持续增长的问题；macOS 26 及以上新增自动清理和手动清理入口，仅清理 Mirage 产生且不再使用的缓存（Issue #77）。 - 改进 Steam 服务无响应时的恢复和退出清理，减少服务进程残留及持续占用 CPU 的问题（Issue #78）。 - 修复场景包使用 `gifscene.pkg` 等自定义文件名时，屏保无法识别已选壁纸的问题（Issue #76）。 - 稳定壁纸自定义面板的布局与更新，正确处理标签中的 HTML 实体，并取消过时的 HTML 内容加载。
## 工坊下载与软件更新
- 新增可选的免登录工坊下载，在“设置 → 通用”输入本机专用激活码后启用；该模式仅支持下载，订阅、收藏和评论仍需登录 Steam。 - 修复自动检查更新与更新提醒，并完善相关设置。 - 发布包改为 Developer ID 签名和 Apple 公证；Sparkle 更新包与更新源继续使用 Ed25519 签名校验。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 应用与屏保组件要求 macOS 14.2 或更高版本；原生动态锁屏功能要求 macOS 26 或更高版本
---
# Mirage 1.1.5
This release adds wallpaper baking and Android wallpaper transfers, improves scene rendering performance, and fixes playback rules, wallpaper caching, Steam service recovery, and screen-saver compatibility. Release packages now use Developer ID signing and Apple notarization.
## Major Update: Wallpaper Baking and Android Transfers
- Added Bake to Video: turn scene, web, and video wallpapers into new SDR video wallpapers using their current properties. Options include resolution presets and custom dimensions, duration, quality, and the wallpaper's own audio, with task progress and cancellation. - Baked videos freeze the original wallpaper's interactive behavior: mouse interaction, clocks, and live media information no longer update, and seamless looping is not guaranteed. Web baking requires Screen Recording permission. - Added Wallpaper Engine Android device discovery, PIN pairing, reconnection to paired devices, and wireless transfer and `.mpkg` export for compatible video and scene wallpapers (PR #30). - Mobile scene export includes quality presets, texture resolution options, and pixel-art optimization. Web wallpapers, scene presets, and prerendered video export are currently unsupported; scene export requires `scene.pkg`.
## Scene Performance and Rendering Compatibility
- Static scenes now render on demand. Reused text layouts, animation data, and GPU resources, and reduced idle audio processing and timer wakeups to avoid unnecessary rendering work. - Fixed scene compositing that caused some wallpapers to render entirely black (Issue #66), and improved composite-layer capture, render-target sizing, pixel coordinates in transform effects, and compatibility with certain lighting effects. - Fixed replacement-image proportions, fill behavior, and crop updates, along with text backgrounds, transparency, positioning, and effect bounds after dynamic text resizing. - Improved SceneScript property initialization, application of initialization return values, and runtime-object binding. Fixed particle instance script binding, manual emission, and oscillation timing and displacement.
## Playback, Caching, and Stability
- Fixed playback rules for other fullscreen apps not triggering on notched displays and with Chrome's multi-window fullscreen layout (Issue #73). - Excluded Siri listening, system alerts, and Control Center volume feedback from other-app audio detection, reducing unnecessary pauses or muting of wallpaper audio (Issue #72). - Fixed continuous desktop wallpaper cache growth. Added automatic and manual cleanup on macOS 26 and later, limited to unused caches created by Mirage (Issue #77). - Improved recovery from an unresponsive Steam service and cleanup on exit, reducing orphaned service processes and sustained CPU usage (Issue #78). - Fixed screen savers failing to recognize selected scenes whose packages use custom filenames such as `gifscene.pkg` (Issue #76). - Stabilized wallpaper customization layout and updates, correctly decoded HTML entities in labels, and cancelled stale HTML content loading.
## Workshop Downloads and Software Updates
- Added optional Workshop downloads without Steam login, enabled with a device-specific activation code under Settings → General. This mode supports downloads only; subscriptions, favorites, and comments still require Steam login. - Fixed automatic update checks and reminders, and improved the related settings. - Release packages now use Developer ID signing and Apple notarization. Sparkle update packages and feeds continue to use Ed25519 signature verification.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later

# Mirage 1.1.4
本版本重点提升网页与 Live2D 壁纸的显示清晰度和渲染稳定性，强化动态锁屏与屏保的恢复能力，并优化媒体信息、界面响应和发布包体积。
## 重大更新：动态锁屏与屏保稳定性
- 改进动态锁屏和屏保的配置生命周期、扩展注册、资源部署及退出流程，减少重复实例、配置覆盖和系统墙纸服务不必要重启导致的问题。 - 动态锁屏预览改为异步生成；系统设置中的壁纸预览和取消操作更可靠，配置失败时保留原有配置。 - 修复自定义壁纸设置在动态锁屏和屏保流程中丢失的问题，并改进屏保播放、退出和跨进程快照处理。 - 修复系统唤醒后播放规则未恢复的问题；同时改进显示器资源释放和屏保播放状态同步。
## 网页与 Live2D 壁纸
- 修复部分网页壁纸在 macOS 显示缩放下分辨率降低、画面清晰度异常的问题（Issue #64）。 - 改进 Live2D 网格缓冲复用、Retina 分辨率适配和窗口尺寸变化处理，减少模糊、渲染停顿及重复上传几何数据的开销。
## 播放与界面改进
- 改进壁纸库、属性编辑器、创意工坊和预览界面的后台处理与刷新策略，减少快速操作、条件计算和资源加载造成的界面卡顿。 - 修复媒体信息颜色提取失败后的重试，并在媒体状态未变化时复用已有的封面调色板，减少重复计算。 - 改进场景运行时和屏幕捕获的隔离处理，减少不同壁纸、屏保和诊断流程之间的状态相互影响。
## 发布包与诊断工具
- 优化渲染器运行时和 FFmpeg 的打包方式，发布包不再依赖目标机器上的 Homebrew 解码组件，并减少重复运行时文件。 - 新增本地化的场景颜色诊断工具，可生成脱敏报告用于定位特定 GPU、驱动或渲染路径下的颜色异常；诊断结果本身不代表问题已修复。
## 下载
- `arm64`：Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64`：Intel Mac - 应用与屏保组件要求 macOS 14.2 或更高版本；原生动态锁屏功能要求 macOS 26 或更高版本
当前构建使用临时签名，首次打开时可能需要在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」中选择“仍要打开”。

# Mirage 1.1.4
This release improves display clarity and rendering stability for web and Live2D wallpapers, strengthens dynamic lock-screen and screen-saver recovery, and improves media metadata handling, UI responsiveness, and package size.
## Major Update: Dynamic Lock Screen and Screen Saver Stability
- Improved the configuration lifecycle, extension registration, resource deployment, and exit paths for dynamic lock screens and screen savers, reducing issues caused by duplicate instances, configuration replacement, and unnecessary wallpaper-service restarts. - Dynamic lock-screen previews are now generated asynchronously. System Settings wallpaper previews and cancellation are more reliable, and the previous configuration is preserved when deployment fails. - Fixed custom wallpaper settings being lost during dynamic lock-screen and screen-saver flows, and improved screen-saver playback, exit handling, and cross-process snapshot processing. - Fixed playback rules not being restored after system wake, and improved display-resource release and screen-saver playback-state synchronization.
## Web and Live2D Wallpapers
- Fixed reduced resolution and unexpected loss of clarity for some web wallpapers when macOS display scaling is enabled (Issue #64). - Improved Live2D mesh-buffer reuse, Retina resolution handling, and resize processing to reduce blur, rendering stalls, and repeated geometry uploads.
## Playback and UI Improvements
- Improved background processing and refresh behavior in the wallpaper library, property editor, Workshop, and previews, reducing UI stalls during rapid interactions, condition evaluation, and resource loading. - Added retries for failed media-artwork color extraction and reused the existing artwork palette when media state is unchanged, reducing repeated work. - Improved isolation for scene runtime and screen capture, reducing state interference between wallpapers, screen savers, and diagnostic sessions.
## Packaging and Diagnostics
- Optimized renderer-runtime and FFmpeg packaging. Release bundles no longer depend on Homebrew decoder components on the target machine and contain fewer duplicated runtime files. - Added localized scene-color diagnostics that generate redacted reports for investigating color issues on specific GPUs, drivers, or rendering paths. Diagnostic results do not by themselves indicate that an issue has been fixed.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.1.3
本版本新增按显示器调整壁纸画面位置、可配置的启动页和菜单栏播放列表切换，优化界面响应与资源加载，并修复场景组件自定义、文字显示及动态锁屏恢复等问题。
## 壁纸位置与操作优化
- 新增场景和视频壁纸的水平、垂直画面位置调整：在填充模式下选择被裁切方向的展示区域，位置按壁纸和显示器分别保存，并支持一键恢复居中，便于在竖屏等不同比例的显示器上调整构图（Issue #54）。 - 通用设置新增“启动时显示”，可选择“已安装”“发现”“创意工坊”或“已订阅”，保存后在下次启动 Mirage 时生效。 - 菜单栏新增播放列表“上一张”和“下一张”，多显示器下可分别操作；顺序播放按列表切换，随机播放支持回到已播放的壁纸，并保留暂停和静音状态。
## 界面响应与加载性能
- 优化壁纸库、创意工坊和下载进度的界面更新，减少无关刷新；合并重复图片请求，按展示尺寸生成缩略图，并限制并发加载，减少重复下载和解码。 - 将壁纸准备、列表筛选、属性条件计算及配置保存移至后台处理，合并连续操作并丢弃过时结果，减少快速切换、连续调参和复杂属性条件造成的界面阻塞。 - 优化开发者日志的批量写入与显示，日志窗口关闭时停止刷新显示文本，降低大量日志对界面响应的影响。
## 场景组件与渲染修复
- 修复场景组件开关及重新启用容器后的子图层可见性；改进组件位置的保存与重置，重置属性时会清除对应场景的脚本存储。 - 修复组件自定义图片与快捷方式图标的加载，支持在属性面板选择文件或文件夹作为快捷方式，并正确传递图标更新。 - 修复文字图层未应用运行时透明度的问题，避免部分壁纸开场动画结束后文字仍残留在画面上（Issue #55）。 - 改进文字字体回退：正确选择字体集合中的字形，跳过占位字体并继续查找可渲染字符，修复音乐信息等场景文字部分缺失的问题（Issue #56）。 - 保留效果显式指定的渲染目标格式，避免被 HDR 场景统一覆盖；修正部分屏幕合成效果的投影矩阵，改善相关效果的渲染兼容性。

# Mirage 1.1.3
This release adds per-display wallpaper positioning, a configurable startup page, and menu bar playlist navigation. It also improves UI responsiveness and resource loading, and fixes Scene component customization, text rendering, and dynamic lock-screen recovery.
## Wallpaper Positioning and Navigation
- Added horizontal and vertical positioning for Scene and video wallpapers in Fill mode. Adjust the visible area along cropped axes, save positions separately for each wallpaper and display, and reset to center with one click. This makes it easier to frame wallpapers on portrait displays and other aspect ratios (Issue #54). - Added a startup-page setting under General. Choose Installed, Discover, Workshop, or Subscribed; the saved choice takes effect the next time Mirage starts. - Added Previous and Next playlist controls to the menu bar, with separate controls for multiple displays. Ordered playback follows the playlist, while random playback can return to previously played wallpapers. Paused and muted states are preserved.
## UI Responsiveness and Loading Performance
- Improved wallpaper library, Workshop, and download-progress updates to reduce unrelated UI refreshes. Duplicate image requests are shared, thumbnails are sized for their display area, and concurrent loading is bounded to reduce repeated downloads and decoding. - Moved wallpaper preparation, list filtering, property-condition evaluation, and configuration saves to background workers. Consecutive operations are coalesced and stale results are discarded, reducing UI blocking during rapid switching, repeated property adjustments, and complex condition evaluation. - Improved developer-log batching and display updates. Closing the log window stops display-text refreshes, reducing the impact of heavy logging on UI responsiveness.
## Scene Component and Rendering Fixes
- Fixed component enable toggles and child-layer visibility after re-enabling a container. Improved component-position persistence and reset behavior; resetting properties now clears the corresponding Scene script storage. - Fixed loading of custom component images and shortcut icons. The property panel now lets users select files or folders as shortcuts and correctly forwards icon updates. - Fixed text layers ignoring runtime opacity, preventing text from remaining on screen after some wallpapers' opening animations finish (Issue #55). - Improved font fallback by selecting the correct face from font collections, skipping placeholder fonts, and continuing the search for renderable glyphs. This fixes missing characters in Scene text such as music information (Issue #56). - Preserved explicitly requested effect render-target formats instead of overriding them with the Scene's HDR format, and corrected projection matrices for some screen-composited effects.
## Dynamic Lock Screen and Screen Saver Fixes
- Fixed desktop wallpaper switching becoming unavailable after unlocking from a dynamic lock screen, and added automatic recovery retries when leaving the Screen Saver Dynamic Lock Screen fails. - Moved configuration preparation for both dynamic lock-screen modes to the background. The native mode finishes resource deployment before replacing the configuration and preserves the previous configuration on failure, reducing UI blocking and unintended configuration replacement. - Improved native dynamic lock-screen extension upgrades, duplicate-instance handling, and configuration acknowledgement, while avoiding unnecessary wallpaper-service restarts. The settings page now shows connection status and provides a retry action. - Fixed dynamic lock-screen snapshot encoding across processes and synchronization of system wallpaper choices when disabled. Disabling the feature hides its choices while retaining the configuration for re-enabling it later.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.1.2
This release substantially improves Wallpaper Engine Scene script and dynamic user-property compatibility, while fixing rendering issues involving custom shaders, dynamic meshes, media textures, and some time-based scenes.
## Major Update: Scene Scripts and Dynamic User Properties
- Fixed `thisLayer` and `thisObject` binding for container and layer scripts, including deferred callbacks, media events, and animation events. Scripts controlling effects can now access and drive the correct effect's animation and visibility. - Expanded Wallpaper Engine script compatibility: field scripts can control their implicit animation directly, and scripts nested in object field bindings are now detected during Scene compilation, reducing cases where scripts were never initialized or media transitions had no effect. - User properties can now update image/text layer scale, text fonts, and text maximum width at runtime, and can control Bloom enablement and parameters live without reloading the wallpaper. - Fixed some scenes being unable to use time-based changes or manually switch their scene time (Issue #51).
## Scene Rendering and Shader Fixes
- Fixed matrix and array uniforms in custom shaders not being padded according to Vulkan `std140` alignment rules, and improved texture-slot reference detection for better compatibility with complex materials. - Fixed dynamic mesh buffers not being seeded with their initial vertex/index data after allocation, which could make some dynamic geometry render incorrectly on its first frame. - Fixed solid-color layers bound to system media textures retaining their authored tint, preventing incorrect coloring and unexpected color blocks in media-backed layers.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.

# Mirage 1.1.1
This release adds macOS Now Playing integration for compatible Scene wallpapers and fixes Scene texture, lighting, text, composition, scripting, interaction, and dynamic lock-screen wake and permission-handling issues.
## System Media Integration
- Added macOS Now Playing integration for compatible Wallpaper Engine scenes. Scenes can now receive playback state, title, artist, album, timeline, and artwork data, and use colors extracted from the artwork to update their visuals dynamically. - Improved artwork requests and track-change refreshes. Mirage now requests artwork data and updates the current and previous artwork correctly when media metadata changes, reducing missing, delayed, or stale cover art.
## Scene Rendering and Interaction Fixes
- Fixed embedded textures with rotation metadata being stretched or rendered with invalid color blocks, and corrected upload extents across mip levels (Issue #39). - Fixed legacy premultiplied lights failing to fall off outside their radius, which could cause local overexposure, and corrected text-layer binding, alignment, and wrapping (Issue #49). - Fixed composite layers linking to the wrong source, unique effects sharing render targets, and script-controlled hidden layers incorrectly participating in the main composition. This prevents content from leaking between layers, missing effects, and misplaced composition results. - Expanded Scene script compatibility by reporting the correct canvas dimensions and layer enumeration, accepting legacy shader declarations with component swizzles, and allowing user clicks to open wallpaper-defined local paths, web links, or email shortcuts. - Fixed interactive layers being hit-tested against unaligned bounds. Mouse clicks and hover events now follow screen-space bounds and authored layer alignment offsets.
## Dynamic Lock Screen Fixes
- Hardened native dynamic lock-screen extension registration by writing configuration before registration, re-registering the containing app, retrying system election, removing duplicate instances, and surfacing actionable registration errors. - Fixed dynamic lock-screen state not recovering after the Mac sleeps and wakes. Mirage now propagates sleep and wake events and reactivates dynamic lock-screen rendering. - Added a Full Disk Access prompt and direct System Settings entry when ad-hoc signing prevents Mirage and its dynamic lock-screen extension from sharing deployment files, replacing silent setup failures with actionable guidance.
## Downloads
- `arm64` for Apple Silicon Mac - `x86_64` for Intel Mac - The app and screen-saver component require macOS 14.2 or later; native dynamic lock-screen features require macOS 26 or later
Builds use ad-hoc signing; macOS may require “Open Anyway” under System Settings → Privacy & Security on first launch.
